scope: Kenya medical discovery — University of Nairobi School of Medicine MBChB

verifiedFacts.claim: The University of Nairobi School of Medicine states that MBChB training lasts six years.

The MBChB programme page specifies a September intake, full-time mode, government-sponsored and self-sponsored routes, published science subject requirements and online application with supporting academic documents.
The official programme page describes 11-week electives after year five, including Kenyatta National Hospital, county hospitals and an overseas option, before final year six.

A Faculty fee table shows MBChB figures, but it does not identify a current academic year or unambiguously establish the applicable international-student fee category; older official booklets show different totals.

holdReasons: No dated, current MBChB fee schedule was captured that identifies the applicable domestic and international category. The undated Faculty table conflicts with older University booklets.
No current MBChB-specific admissions call establishes the next application opening, deadline, spaces or the precise international applicant route.
The reviewed English-language materials support an English-facing programme page but do not provide a separate official language-of-instruction policy statement.
No current primary recognition source from the Kenyan medical regulator was captured for public recognition badges.
nextAction: Obtain a current, dated MBChB fee circular covering international applicants, the next MBChB intake notice and a regulator recognition record before creating a public payload.
